paper_level_summary_zh: 该论文在相关工作中将目标论文列为RFID-based methods的代表性作品，提及其实现了通过COTS RFID标签进行穿墙扬声器窃听，但未提供具体细节或评价其性能。

evidences.evidence_quote: As for RFID-based methods, researchers have explored the possibility of using COTS RFID tags to perform the thru-the-wall eavesdropping on the loudspeaker [50].
evidences.evidence_context: The RF-based methods can be classified according to the RF technologies used, including WiFi, RFID, and mmWave. ... As for RFID-based methods, researchers have explored the possibility of using COTS RFID tags to perform the thru-the-wall eavesdropping on the loudspeaker [50].
